channel.title: Architect Tomorrow
channel.description: Jagadeesh Devaraj: enterprise architecture, engineering, reliability, cloud and AI.

item.title: AI Doesn't Remove Architecture. It Changes Where Architecture Matters.
item.description: As AI systems move into production, architecture increasingly extends beyond components and interfaces into data, evaluation, models, agents, security and operational behaviour.

item.title: Architecture Is Not the Diagram
item.description: Architecture decisions are ultimately decisions about constraints, trade-offs and the future behaviour of a system.

item.title: Reliability Is a Product Decision Before It Becomes an Engineering Problem
item.description: Engineering can improve reliability, but an organisation first has to decide what level of failure it is willing to tolerate.
